Executive Order 10931
AMENDMENT OF SECTION 1  OF  
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 10673,1  
ESTABLISHING THE PRESIDENT’S  
COUNCIL ON YOUTH FITNESS
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me as President of the United States, it is 
ordered as follows:
S e c t io n 1. Section 1  of Executive 
Order No. 10673 of July 16, 1956, as 
amended, is hereby further amended to 
read as follows:
“ Se c t io n 1. There is hereby estab­
lished the President’s Council on Youth 
Fitness (hereinafter referred to as the 
Council), which shall be composed of the
121 F.R. 5341; 3 CFR, 1956 Supp., p. 82.
Secretary of Health, Education, and 
Welfare, who shall be the Chairman of 
the Council, the Secretary of Defense, 
the Attorney General, the Secretary of 
the Interior, the Secretary of Agricul­
ture, the Secretary of Commerce, the 
Secretary of Labor, and the Housing and 
Home Finance Administrator.”
S e c. 2. The following-described or­
ders, amending section 1  of Executive 
Order No. 10673, are hereby revoked:
Executive Order No. 10704 of March 
25, 1957. *
Executive Order No. 10740 of Novem­
ber 21, 1957.
Executive Order No. 10785 of October 
17, 1958.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Paragraph1 membership mandate continues amended through10740/10785, rather than ending on the changed membership or immediate execution of the amendment. Both are expressly revoked by10931 sec2 on1961-03-29. No separate deadline, savings or performance condition; no deferred effectiveness. Original membership/parent linkage and both after-texts are retained in the later events.

research_rationale:
EO10704 contains exactly two operative paragraphs: membership and the conforming amendment to parent EO10673 section1. Its hereafter membership rule took effect on signing1957-03-25; no deferred date, report deadline, sunset, contingent completion, or separate command appears. EO10740 and10785 later change the membership, continued amended under the owner2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling. Reusing the carried Sinclair cross-family correction, the earlier-displacement theory is rejected; these are later events, not first endings. EO10931 section2 expressly and unconditionally revokes EO10704 by number and date, with no delayed commencement or savings; both paragraphs therefore end1961-03-29. Its section1 installs the next parent membership, distinct from the target's revocation. Complete official pages of10704,10740,10785,10931,10673,10772,11074 were independently inspected in this producer context. EO10673's reporting/agency assistance/advisory duties belong to the parent, not an unlisted EO10704 command. EO10772 changes only parent section4. EO11074 sections3-4 preserve independent agency functions and Council institutional continuity; section6 revokes10673/10772/10931 without restoring10704. This preserves institutional history without treating continued Council existence as continued target authority. The status remains the adopted provisional NO; prior status reviews do not approve this whole lifecycle. Held OCR is quoted exactly including harmless recognition artifacts and was compared with retained page images. Bounded search coverage and complete source pins are recorded in RESEARCH.v1.md and SOURCE_MANIFEST.v1.json beside the packet; no universal absence claim or human certification is made.

savings_residuals.reason: Neither EO10704 nor EO10931 saves a target clause, delegation, individual right, pending proceeding, accrued payment, property transfer, or unresolved duty. The original only resets the Council's membership and conforms parent section1. Parent EO10673 sections2-7 continue their own functions until their later disposition; EO11074 section4 expressly continues the institution in1963 and section3(a) protects independent statutory agency functions. Those are disclosed institutional/independent effects, not surviving EO10704 membership authority. Revocation of10931 in1963 contains no restoration of10704. No target-specific continuing residual was found in the bounded held-corpus/OFR/current-law searches; USC coverage stops2026-10-09, while the CFR and OFR searches cover the2026-10-14 cutoff.
